title: GST for service businesses in India
description: Which GST rate applies to services, when to charge IGST versus CGST plus SGST, and what every tax invoice must contain.
html:
Short answer: most services in India attract 18% GST; charge IGST on inter-state supply and CGST + SGST within one state.

Which GST rate applies?

Most services fall under 18% GST. Export-related services may be 0% (export of services).

IGST vs CGST+SGST

Inter-state = IGST; intra-state = CGST + SGST.

Invoice requirements

GSTIN of both parties, SAC code, place of supply, and tax breakup are mandatory. Try our GST Invoice Generator.

title: SEO basics every startup needs
description: The handful of search-engine fundamentals a new site needs before any paid growth: crawlable pages, clear titles, useful content and a sitemap.
html:
Short answer: make every important page crawlable, give it one clear topic, a unique title and description, and publish content that answers the question a customer actually types.

1. Make pages crawlable

Search engines and AI assistants read your HTML first. Pages that only appear after heavy JavaScript can be missed, so make sure key content is present in the page source.

2. One topic per page

Give each page a unique title and meta description that say what the page is, in plain words, and a single H1 that matches.

3. Answer real questions

Lead with the direct answer, then add detail. Pricing, timelines and comparisons are what buyers search for.

4. Ship the basics

Publish a sitemap, a robots file, fast mobile pages, and register the site in Google Search Console so you can see what is indexed.

title: Mobile app vs web app trade-offs
description: When a web app is enough, when you need a native or cross-platform mobile app, and how cost, speed and reach compare.
html:
Short answer: start with a web app if you need reach and speed to market; build a mobile app when you depend on device features, push notifications or repeat daily use.

Web app

One codebase, no app-store review, instantly updatable, and discoverable through search. Best for validating an idea, dashboards, marketplaces and internal tools.

Mobile app

Better access to the camera, location, offline use and push notifications, and a home-screen presence. A cross-platform framework such as React Native can cover iOS and Android from one codebase.

How to decide

If users come from search or links, begin on the web. If your product is used daily or needs the device hardware, plan for mobile. Many products launch web first and add a mobile app once usage is proven.

title: Measuring AI automation ROI
description: A simple way to estimate payback on an AI or workflow-automation project: hours saved, error reduction, run cost and build cost.
html:
Short answer: ROI = (value of time and errors saved per month − monthly run cost) ÷ build cost. Payback is build cost divided by the monthly net saving.

1. Measure the manual baseline

Count how many times the task happens each month, how long it takes, and the loaded hourly cost of the person doing it.

2. Estimate the saving

Multiply hours saved by hourly cost. Add the cost of errors, rework and delays that the automation removes.

3. Subtract running costs

Include model or API usage, hosting and a little maintenance time each month.

4. Compare with the build cost

Divide the build cost by the monthly net saving to get the payback period. Prefer processes that are frequent, rule-based and high volume.

  • Custom GPT / RAG Bot — from ₹80,000 per project, about 14 days

  • AI-Powered Search — from ₹35,000 per feature, about 7-10 days
  • AI Content Generator — from ₹40,000 per project, about 8 days

FAQ bot vs RAG bot

A FAQ chatbot answers a fixed set of questions you provide. A RAG bot searches your documents, help centre or product data and writes an answer from what it finds, so it handles questions you didn't list in advance but takes more work to build and test.

What changes the price

  • Where the knowledge lives: a few pages versus thousands of documents.
  • Channels: website, WhatsApp or in-app.
  • Hand-off and analytics: escalating to a human and measuring answers adds scope.
  • Ongoing usage: model and hosting costs continue after launch.
